TRAFFIC ADVISORY
PROJECTS COMMISSIONING IN THE FCT
DAY 13 - MONDAY 30TH JUNE, 2025

Construction of the newly constructed road in Giri.

All roads lead to Giri, the EFCC Academy site and Venue for dignitaries and invited guests.
Connecting points along the Airport Road - Bill Clinton Junction - Giri and beyond the road heading towards the newly created U-turn will be managed such that traffic will be stopped intermittently to allow for movement of dignitaries.

Traffic control personnel and security agents will be deployed accordingly.

There will be no major diversion at about 1100am when movement will be activated.

- Head Traffic, DRTS
